duration_h.quote: Be prepared to be self-sufficient for at least 72 hours.

resources.label: Drinking water
resources.quote: Water is important for drinking, cooking and sanitation. You will need about four litres per person, per day.

resources.label: Floor space
resources.quote: 4.5–5.5 square metres of living space per person in cold climates or urban settings where internal cooking space and bathing and/or sanitation facilities are included.
resources.note: Lower end of the Sphere range for cold or urban settings.

resources.label: Cooled floor space
resources.note: Same Sphere floor-space rate applied to a cooled room during heat (team assumption that the rate carries over).
